title: Minimum Generations to Target Point
summary: Starting with generation-zero points in three dimensions, each new generation adds the coordinatewise floored midpoint of every pair of distinct coordinate triples available in earlier generations. Generate the whole generation simultaneously; newly produced points cannot help until the next generation. Return the earliest generation containing target, zero if initially present, or -1 if impossible. Identical-coordinate points cannot be paired.
officialConstraints: 1..20 distinct initial triples; all initial and target coordinates are integers 0..6; target has three coordinates.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
